title: pix_opencv_hough_circles
description: `pix_opencv_hough_circles` applies a Hough circle-detection algorithm to image input and reports each detected circle’s X/Y position and radius. Its detector resolution, minimum circle distance, thresholds, night mode, and maximum number of detected circles can be configured with messages such as `resolution`, `mindist`, `threshold`, `threshold2`, `nightmode`, and `maxcircles`.
